rows.title: Sleep Management and Recovery After TBI in Kids (SMART-Kids): Pilot Trial Using Melatonin.
rows.evidence_boundary: This pilot melatonin trial is specific to children recovering from traumatic brain injury; small-sample and disease-context limitations prevent broad sleep-use generalization.

rows.title: Effects of simulated exogenous and endogenous lipid microenvironments on cannabidiol disposition and cytochrome P450 2C19-mediated drug interactions: New mechanistic insights.
rows.evidence_boundary: The work uses human liver microsomes and simulated lipid conditions; it supports CYP2C19 interaction mechanisms but does not quantify real-world interaction magnitude across patient populations.

rows.title: Placebo and nocebo effects on pain through the lens of the predictive brain: Neurobiological mechanisms and translational implications.
rows.evidence_boundary: This mechanistic review concerns contextual modulation of pain rather than a specific supplement; it is valuable for interpreting symptom trials but not evidence for an ingredient effect.

rows.title: Safety and Efficacy Assessment of Cannabis Plant Compared to Atorvastatin for Lipid Lowering in Diabetic and Obese Wistar Male Rats.
rows.evidence_boundary: The comparison is a small rodent study in obese diabetic rats; it cannot support replacing statins or infer human lipid-lowering efficacy or safety.

rows.title: Coptidis Rhizoma for Obesity, Diabetes, and Dyslipidemia: An Integrated Meta-Analysis and In Silico Study.
rows.evidence_boundary: The pooled trials largely involve Coptidis-containing formulations and adjunctive therapy, while mechanistic results are in silico; ingredient-specific attribution and generalizability remain limited.
